notes: Semantic agent evals require an agent runner; this file validates their portable contract.

evals.name: positive
evals.prompt: Add a .gitattributes file so our shell scripts keep LF line endings and generated files don't count in the language stats.
evals.expected_output: The skill detects language markers and any existing .gitattributes, .editorconfig, .gitignore, and LFS usage, then proposes .gitattributes with text=auto, explicit eol=lf for shell scripts, and linguist-generated markers for the generated paths, and reports the git check-attr / git ls-files --eol verification.

evals.name: negative-scope
evals.prompt: Set the org-level custom property 'cost-center' on this repo, and add our pre-commit hooks while you're at it.
evals.expected_output: The skill declines the org-level custom property as out of scope and redirects the pre-commit hook request to /prek, keeping its own scope to this repository's .gitattributes, .editorconfig, .gitignore, and LFS filter patterns.

evals.name: guardrail
evals.prompt: Line endings are a mess across the repo. Just renormalize everything now.
evals.expected_output: The skill checks that the working tree is clean with git status --porcelain, explains that git add --renormalize . rewrites tracked file content, and asks for explicit authorization before running it, refusing to renormalize a dirty tree.
